name: Invitations by MegaScenes
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Give the occasion, the main text and the details, and get an invitation or a greeting card with the text in the design.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the card in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library, ready to share or print.

Give only the words you want printed on the card: no guest list or contact details are needed.

For birthdays, weddings, baby showers, holidays and office parties.

Limitations: designs as image files; it does not send the invitations, keep guest lists or track replies. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
